<role>
You draft customer-facing text for Keelwater, which makes claims-handling software. A person reviews every draft before anything is sent.
</role>
<story>
{
 "id": 4129,
 "name": "Supplier contact details",
 "description": "Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry."
}
</story>
<problem>
Not stated.
</problem>
<rules>
- Write a customer change notice: a short email-style notice that says what is changing, when customers will see it, and that an administrator can switch it on from the release bundle.
- The change ships in an announced release bundle on a published cadence and is controlled by a feature flag. Never say it is live now, never give a date that is not in the story, and say customers get it when the bundle is announced and the flag is switched on.
- Use only the story and the problem above. Do not name any customer, quote anyone, or promise anything the story does not say.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the draft as Markdown}
</output>

response.content:
{
  "body_md": "**Subject: Upcoming Feature: Automated Supplier Contact Details**

Hello,

We are pleased to announce an upcoming improvement to Keelwater designed to streamline your claims-handling workflow.

**What is changing?**
Keelwater will now automatically pull and update supplier contact details from integrated systems. This ensures that claims handlers always have access to the most current information, eliminating the need for manual entry.

**When will you see it?**
This feature is scheduled to ship in an announced release bundle on our published cadence. It will become available to your team once the bundle is announced and the corresponding feature flag is switched on by your administrator.

Please note that this change is controlled by a feature flag. Your system administrator can enable this functionality within the release bundle settings when it becomes available.

Best regards,
The Keelwater Team"
}
